invariant: A historical split does not become an unambiguous material assignment merely because only one successor is active later. Assignment requires an explicit validated material revision.
observed_failure: The original detail appeared as linked material under the surviving issue after its sibling was withdrawn. Recombination reproduced the same failure in the focused regression.
repair: Stop inherited material-link resolution at a historical node with multiple successors. Preserve the original detail as unresolved, direct valid links and unambiguous single-successor chains. Explicit material correction resolves assignment while retaining history.
